subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Analisar a função e as flexões de substantivos e adjetivos e de verbos nos modos Indicativo, Subjuntivo e Imperativo: afirmativo e negativo.

components.description_pt: Identificar a função gramatical de nomes e adjetivos em sentenças
components.description_en: Identify the grammatical function of nouns and adjectives in sentences
components.cc_component_description: Explain the general grammatical function of each of the five major parts of speech

components.description_pt: Analisar flexões de nomes e adjetivos para gênero, número e grau
components.description_en: Analyze inflections of nouns and adjectives for gender, number, and degree
components.cc_component_description: Form regular plural nouns orally by adding /s/ to singular nouns

components.description_pt: Formar e usar verbos nos modos indicativo, imperativo, interrogativo, condicional e subjuntivo
components.description_en: Form and use verbs in the indicative, imperative, interrogative, conditional, and subjunctive moods
components.cc_component_description: Form and use verbs in the indicative, imperative, interrogative, conditional, and subjunctive moods

components.description_pt: Identificar formas afirmativas e negativas de verbos nos três modos
components.description_en: Identify affirmative and negative forms of verbs across the three moods
components.cc_component_description: Form and use verbs in the indicative, imperative, interrogative, conditional, and subjunctive moods

components.description_pt: Explicar mudanças de significado produzidas por alterações no modo verbal
components.description_en: Explain meaning changes produced by shifts in verb mood in a given context
components.cc_component_description: Evaluate the effect of verb voice and mood choices on meaning in written texts

cc_matches.description: Demonstrate command of the conventions of standard English grammar and usage when writing or speaking.
Form regular plural nouns orally by adding /s/ or /es/ (e.g., dog, dogs; wish, wishes).
Explain the function of nouns, pronouns, verbs, adjectives, and adverbs in general and their functions in particular sentences.
Use knowledge of language and its conventions when writing, speaking, reading, or listening.
